sources.title: Enforcement measures for landlords: Renters' Rights Act 2025
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: New tenancy-reform enforcement measures apply to assured tenancies from 1 May 2026. Whether a candidate property is within scope depends on its tenancy and occupation facts.

sources.title: Repossessing your privately rented property after 1 May 2026
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The current possession guidance reflects Part 1 of the Renters' Rights Act 2025 and removal of section 21 from 1 May 2026. This is tenancy-regulation context, not candidate occupancy evidence.

sources.title: House in multiple occupation licence
sources.verified_claim: Large HMOs require licensing and smaller HMOs may require a licence depending on local schemes. Exact licensing depends on occupier/household facts and local designation.

sources.title: Houses in multiple occupation
sources.verified_claim: Enfield requires mandatory or additional HMO licensing, with borough-wide additional HMO licensing from 1 September 2025. This does not establish that parcel_30762 is an HMO or rented.

sources.title: Apply for a property licence
sources.verified_claim: Havering's new selective and additional licensing designations took effect 18 March 2026, with selective licensing in seven wards and additional HMO licensing borough-wide. Candidate ward/use must be matched before applicability is asserted.

sources.title: New property licensing schemes launched
sources.verified_claim: The council confirmed the 18 March 2026 start of new selective and additional HMO licensing schemes and enforcement expectations. Launch status is not candidate-property licensing status.

sources.title: HMOs that require a licence
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth states mandatory, additional and section 257 HMOs can require licensing. Candidate occupation structure is unknown and therefore no licence requirement is inferred.

sources.title: Additional HMO licensing
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's borough-wide additional HMO scheme covers qualifying properties with three or more individuals outside mandatory licensing and requires extensive supporting evidence. No candidate is treated as licensable without occupancy facts.
